name: Air
desc: Breathable air, scrubbed and topped up. Nobody notices it until a scrubber stops.
shortage_text: Headaches on the lower decks. Candles gutter, bunks empty.
glut_text: The scrubbers run quiet and the air tastes of nothing.

name: Water
desc: Drinking water: reclaimed, melted, filtered. A resident drinks about a litre of the stuff a day, give or take.
shortage_text: Rationing. Jugs go for triple and the queues start before shift.
glut_text: Taps run full. Nobody hoards a jug.

name: Food
desc: Calories in any form: rations, vat bread, whatever grew. One need unit is one resident fed for a day.
shortage_text: Empty shelves in the galleys. Ration bars change hands for coins.
glut_text: Vat halls overproduce. Bread is cheap and nobody argues over a bar.

name: Power
desc: Charge in cells: for lamps, tools, machines, stoves. Spent faster than anyone budgets.
shortage_text: Brownouts and dim corridors. A full cell is worth a day of wages.
glut_text: Cells are cheap and chargers idle. Lights stay on.

name: Medicine
desc: Pills, bandages, antiseptic, what the clinic cannot get to in time.
shortage_text: The clinic runs out of antibiotics. Pain is rationed and private sellers get rich.
glut_text: Shelves of painkillers and dust on the antiseptic.

name: Parts
desc: Spares and tools for everything that breaks, which is everything. Valves, bearings, fasteners, filters.
shortage_text: Repairs wait for parts. Crews strip dead machines for spares.
glut_text: Bins full of fasteners. Repair crews idle.

name: Comfort
desc: Light, softness, small things that make a bunk a home. Not survival, but people leave without it.
shortage_text: Grey corridors and tempers short. A lamp sells before it is priced.
glut_text: Warm light at every door. Decoration is cheap.

name: Luxury
desc: Drink, books, jewellery, something nobody needs. The ring lives on it, the spine dreams of it.
shortage_text: The ring shuts its doors. Wine goes to the black market.
glut_text: Wine at every table. Nobody notices a locket.
